taylor: Quick notice — short KV-prefix prefill + traffic-shaping experiment tomorrow 2026-07-12 03:00 UTC (30m). Goal: measure warm-hit improvement and p99 delta ahead of quantized model rollout. Internal-only SLO change: /v1/generate p99 relaxed 120ms -> 220ms for canary traffic.

mina: scope? regions/tenants?

taylor: Canary only (~8%): region-usw2 + region-eu1. Opt-in customers + internal tests. No dedicated capacity impacted.

jamal: oncall here, acked. Ill watch healthchecks and be ready to rollback.

rohit: share runbook and thresholds pls.

taylor: short runbook: 1) dashboards: https://dash.board/redwood/kvcache-prefill 2) if p99 > 300ms OR error_rate > 0.5% for 3m -> rollback: `rdctl routing set /v1/generate default` 3) if GPU mem > 85% -> disable via flag `feature-flag set kvcache_prefill=false`. Tag as experiment.

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: KV-prefill experiment starts in 10m. :bell:

mina: infra note — expect read-heavy KV-store traffic on canaries; infra will monitor IO.

deploy-bot: deploy started: kvcache-prefill-v3 -> canary-pool (id d-100201). CI logs: https://ci/redwood/d-100201

jamal: confirmed. Quiet window set for noisy non-prod jobs. Ill escalate if alerts hit.

taylor: TL;DR — 30m experimental window, internal p99 relaxation for canary /v1/generate, runbook + dash posted, oncall + infra watching. Ping me or @jamal with issues. :rocket:
